_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow (1807-1882) as translator. Dante's Divine Comedy (1867, line-for-line blank verse) and the TRANSLATIONS section of his Complete Poetical Works (Coplas de Manrique, Spanish, Scandinavian, German, Anglo-Saxon, French, Italian incl. Michelangelo, Portuguese, Eastern pieces). PD. Added 2026-10-02 at the coordinator's relay; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.

longfellow-inferno: Dante, Divine Comedy: Hell, tr. Longfellow
longfellow-purgatorio: Dante, Divine Comedy: Purgatory, tr. Longfellow
longfellow-paradiso: Dante, Divine Comedy: Paradise, tr. Longfellow
longfellow-poetical-works: Complete Poetical Works of Longfellow (source of the Translations section)

longfellow-translations.work: Translations (Complete Poetical Works): Coplas de Manrique, Spanish ballads and sonnets, Frithiof's Saga passages, German lyrics, Beowulf passage, French, Italian (Michelangelo sonnets, Dante passages), Portuguese, Eastern
longfellow-translations.note: Stops before 'From the Latin' (Virgil Eclogue I, Ovid Tristia III.10/12): non-Dryden Ovid and Virgil belong to lane B's author sections, never a translator shelf of lane C.
